BJP Announces National Office Bearers Reshuffle

The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) has announced a significant reshuffling of its national office bearers. President J.P. Nadda unveiled the new team, which includes Vasundhara Raje and Ram Madhav appointed as national vice presidents. Smriti Irani has been named the national general secretary, a role she expressed gratitude for. Other key appointments include Piyush Goyal and BL Santhosh in significant positions. The reshuffle also saw Sanjay Bhatia and Satish Poonia receiving major responsibilities. The new team was announced by President Nitin Nabin.
